stories.h: Canada courts $120 trillion in global capital to reduce US dependence
stories.w: Prime Minister Mark Carney is pitching energy, critical minerals and trade access to 300 senior investors as Washington tries to pull factories and investment south.

stories.h: Trump downplays AI guardrails in race with China
stories.w: The president said winning the technology contest would help manage its risks while offering no specific regulatory framework, sharpening the direction of US policy on a system with economy-wide consequences.

stories.h: Trump asks Ukraine to stop striking Russian diesel infrastructure
stories.w: The request links Kyiv's campaign against Russian refining capacity to record US diesel prices and a wider shortage intensified by restricted Gulf exports, inserting energy pressure into wartime diplomacy.

stories.h: Congo's record Ebola outbreak remains uncontrolled after reaching a seventh province
stories.w: The westward jump to South-Ubangi widens the response challenge beyond the eastern epicentre as official totals pass 7,000 cases and approach 3,400 deaths amid conflict and displacement.

stories.h: Killings deepen Nigeria-South Africa dispute over migrant safety
stories.w: Nigeria says two more nationals were killed, one after alleged police interrogation, as anti-migrant violence forces thousands from South Africa and strains relations across the continent.

stories.h: Yemen fighting intensifies around a vital Red Sea shipping corridor
stories.w: Houthi gains near Bab el-Mandeb, renewed attacks on Saudi Arabia and more than 82,000 newly displaced people threaten another full civil war while adding pressure to global energy routes.

stories.h: BRICS agrees on an infectious-disease warning system and deeper payment links
stories.w: The expanded bloc, representing about half the world's population, closed its summit with commitments spanning outbreak preparedness, local-currency trade and cross-border payments despite internal geopolitical tensions.

stories.h: More than 30 missing after Vanuatu inter-island ferry sinks
stories.w: Fifteen people were rescued and one death confirmed after a 45-person ferry went down in rough seas, exposing the difficulty of mounting rapid search operations across a dispersed island nation.
